content: The dissertation dates his residence in Yazd ca. 825-29/1422-26 and calls it a relatively uneventful, productive period in which he wrote many lettrist works (Anjām, Suʾl al-Mulūk, Shaqq-i Qamar, Nuqṭa, Inzāliyya, Muḥammadiyya, Sharḥ al-Basmala) and revised the Mafāḥiṣ with Sharaf al-Dīn Yazdī.
